class.name: DisGeoOrigin
class.brief_description: Places a geographic point at the origin of the scene and converts between ECEF and scene coordinates.
class.description: DIS positions are geocentric (ECEF) coordinates, millions of metres from the scene. [DisGeoOrigin] defines which point on Earth ([member latitude], [member longitude], [member height]) sits at the scene's [code](0, 0, 0)[/code] and converts positions, directions and orientations in both directions. Add one to the scene; [DisEntity] and [DisEntityManager] find it through the group [code]dis_geo_origin[/code] unless they have an [code]origin_path[/code]. The scene is the local tangent plane at the origin: +X is east, +Y is up, -Z is north, one unit is one metre. A level entity facing north has the identity basis. The subtraction of the origin is done in double precision; only the small local result is rounded to 32 bits. [codeblock] func _on_entity_state(pdu: DisEntityStatePdu) -> void: $Tank.transform = $DisGeoOrigin.dis_to_transform(pdu.location_ecef, pdu.orientation) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] The Earth curves away below the tangent plane: about 8 m at 10 km and 785 m at 100 km from the origin. Keep scenes within a few hundred kilometres of the origin; [Vector3] precision also drops far from [code](0, 0, 0)[/code].

method.name: basis_to_dis_euler
method.description: Converts a scene [Basis] to a DIS orientation [code]Vector3(psi, theta, phi)[/code] in radians, relative to ECEF at this origin. The Basis is orthonormalized first, so scale is ignored. The entity is taken to look along -Z with +Y up and +X right. Note that the result is relative to the tangent plane at the origin, not at the entity's own location.

method.name: dis_euler_to_basis
method.description: Converts a DIS orientation [param orientation] [code]Vector3(psi, theta, phi)[/code], in radians, to a scene [Basis] (the entity looks along -Z, +Y is up, +X is right). See [method basis_to_dis_euler].

method.name: dis_to_transform
method.description: Returns a [Transform3D] with the basis of [method dis_euler_to_basis] for [param orientation] and the origin of [method ecef_to_local] for [param location_ecef].

method.name: ecef_to_local
method.description: Converts an ECEF position [param ecef] ([PackedFloat64Array] of 3 values, metres) to scene coordinates.

method.name: ecef_vector_to_local
method.description: Converts a direction or velocity [param vector] given in ECEF axes (for example in m/s) to scene axes. Only the rotation is applied, there is no translation.

method.name: geodetic_to_local
method.description: Converts [param latitude] and [param longitude] (degrees) and [param height] (metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid) to scene coordinates.

method.name: get_origin_ecef
method.description: Returns the ECEF position of the scene origin as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][x, y, z][/code] in metres.

method.name: local_to_ecef
method.description: Converts a scene position to an ECEF position, returned as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][x, y, z][/code] in metres.

method.name: local_to_geodetic
method.description: Converts a scene position to a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][latitude, longitude, height][/code]: degrees, degrees, metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

method.name: local_vector_to_ecef
method.description: Converts a direction or velocity [param vector] in scene axes to ECEF axes. Only the rotation is applied, there is no translation.

method.name: set_origin_geodetic
method.description: Sets [member latitude], [member longitude] and [member height] at once. [param latitude] is clamped to the range -90 to 90.

members.member: Height of the scene origin in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid (not above sea level).
Latitude of the scene origin in degrees, clamped to -90 to 90.
Longitude of the scene origin in degrees (positive east).
